items.title: Airbnb to Require Temporary Phone Numbers for Large Hosts and Guests
items.snippet: Skift Take: Airbnb says the temporary phone numbers are meant to protect privacy. But the change also makes it harder for property managers to turn Airbnb guests into direct bookers. Starting October 30, Airbnb will issue temporary phone numbers to guests and to large hosts and property managers in the U.S. and Canada.

items.title: The Urban Escape: Inside Faena New York’s Spectacular Spa
items.snippet: From meetings to massages, Faena New York’s Tierra Santa Healing House offers business travelers a luxurious urban escape, blending South American healing rituals, indulgent treatments and an extraordinary thermal sanctuary.

items.title: Hilton raises full-year RevPAR outlook after ‘strong’ Q3 results
items.snippet: Systemwide RevPAR increased 5.8% year over year during the quarter, driven by strength in demand and “favorable macro trends,” CEO Chris Nassetta said on an earnings call.

items.title: BWH® Hotels Unveils Enterprise Transformation, Uniting Global Portfolio Under WorldHotels™
items.snippet: BWH Hotels is rebranding under the WorldHotels masterbrand, consolidating 4,000+ properties and 18 brands into a single loyalty program with 70 million members and a new digital platform.

items.title: TAAI Convention charts new course for India’s travel trade amid AI-led transformation
items.snippet: The Travel Agents Association of India’s (TAAI) 69th Convention & Exhibition – Indian Travel Congress 2026 concludes in Kolkata tonight, bringing together travel agents, airlines, hotel groups, tourism boards and technology providers to discuss the changing dynamics of India’s travel and tourism industry.

items.title: It’s a wrap! THINC Sri Lanka & Maldives
items.snippet: It’s a wrap! THINC Sri Lanka & Maldives by Hotelivate | Oct 27, 2026 After a six-year hiatus, Hotelivate-Savills returned to Colombo for the fourth edition of the Tourism Hotel Investment & Networking Conference (THINC). The last edition of the conference was held in 2019, making this year's gathering particularly significant for the region's hospitality industry.

items.title: Baden-Württemberg hosts FAM Trips to attract Indian travellers
items.snippet: Tourismus Marketing GmbH Baden-Württemberg (TMBW), in partnership with Air India, organised two familiarisation (FAM) trips for Indian travel trade and corporate representatives to showcase the tourism offerings of Baden-Württemberg in southwestern Germany.

items.title: Kalyani Developers to expand Hospitality Portfolio to over 1400 Keys
items.snippet: Bengaluru based Kalyani Developers is set to significantly expand its hospitality portfolio, targeting over 1400 keys over the next two years across Bengaluru and Hyderabad.

items.title: Shree Naman Group Completes LandmarkAcquisition of JW Marriott Bengaluru and Crowne Plaza Pune
items.snippet: Shree Naman Group, has completed the acquisition of JW Marriott Bengaluru for ₹1,611 crore and Crowne Plaza Pune for ₹189 crore, marking a landmark expansion of its hospitality business. The ₹1,800-crore transaction was completed on 1 October 2026, within 30 days of approval by the National Company Law Tribunal on 3 September 2026, following a competitive bidding process.

items.title: MMT reports net profit of $1.8 million in Q2, revenues at $235.2 million
items.snippet: MakeMyTrip reported a $1.8 million Q2 net profit, reversing a year-earlier loss of $5.7 million. Revenue rose 11.2% to $235.2 million, while gross bookings grew 20.9%, supported by hotels, transport and AI-powered travel assistant Myra. MakeMyTrip has reported a net profit of $1.8 million in quarter two of this fiscal year compared to a net loss of $5.7 million in the corresponding period of the previous fiscal year.
